introText: Small groups are where faith becomes everyday — we pray for one another, study Scripture together and support each other in good times and hard ones. Choose a group below to see more details.

grupuri.descriere: For teenagers and young adults — time for worship, open conversations and genuine friendships.
grupuri.detalii: We meet weekly to grow together in faith, in a relaxed and open atmosphere where every question is welcome.

grupuri.descriere: Couples and families growing together in faith and supporting one another.
grupuri.detalii: A safe space for couples and families, where we talk about family life from a biblical perspective and support one another through good times and hard ones.

grupuri.descriere: A time dedicated to prayer for the church, the community and everyone's needs.
grupuri.detalii: We gather to pray together for the church, for the Lisaura community, and for each person's personal needs.
